blocks.text: Grade 10 高频词汇 501–600
proximity /prɒk'simiti/ n. 接近, 亲近
You put your body there in proximity to, adjacent to, alongside, within.
中文语境：你把你的身体放在靠近、毗邻、旁边、里面
displace /dis'pleis/ v.t. 移置, 替换, 转移
Occasionally, a white light flickers by like a displaced sound.
中文语境：偶尔会有一道白光闪烁，就像一种错位的声音
suspicion /sə'spiʃən/ n. 怀疑, 觉察, 嫌疑；[法] 怀疑, 疑心, 嫌疑
What does suspicion mean?
中文语境：怀疑是什么意思？
acknowledge /ək'nɒlidʒ/ v.t. 承认, 告知收悉, 答谢, 报偿；[经] 承认, 答谢, 收到的通知
The man doesn't acknowledge you as you sit down because the man knows more about the unoccupied seat than you do.
中文语境：当你坐下时，这个人并没有认出你，因为他比你更了解空着的座位
overthrow /.əuvə'θrəu/ n. 推翻, 瓦解, 倾覆；v.t. 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆
For those whom thou think'st thou dost overthrow
中文语境：对于那些你认为你已经推翻的人
delivery /di'livəri/ n. 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡；[化] 交货额
Rest of their bones, and soul's delivery.
中文语境：他们的骨头安息，灵魂得救
poison /'pɒizn/ n. 毒药, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物；v.t. 毒害, 毒杀, 使中毒；v.i. 放毒, 下毒
And dost with poison, war, and sickness dwell,
中文语境：毒药、战争和疾病居住在其中，
stroke /strəuk/ n. 笔划, 打, 中风, 抚, 摩, 冲程；v.t. 划尾桨, 抚, 摩, 划去；[计] 笔划
And better than thy stroke; why swell'st thou then?
中文语境：比你的中风更好；那你为什么膨胀呢？
flake /fleik/ n. 小薄片, 扁薄的一层, 火星, 晒鱼架子；v.t. 使成薄片；v.i. 剥落
Of easy wind and downy flake.
中文语境：轻松的风和柔软的片状
harness /'hɑːnis/ n. 马具, 挽具状带子, 甲胄；v.t. 给...上挽具, 驾驭, 披上甲胄, 利用...以产生动力
He gives his harness bells a shake
中文语境：他摇了摇他的马具铃
queer /kwiə/ n. 怪人, 同性恋者；adj. 奇怪的, 不舒服的, 可疑的；v.t. 搞糟
My little horse must think it queer
中文语境：我的小马一定觉得很奇怪
wood /wud/ n. 木材, 木制品；v.t. 植林于, 给...添加木柴；v.i. 收集木材
Whose woods these are I think I know.
中文语境：我想我知道这些是谁的树林
sweep /swiːp/ n. 扫除, 打扫, 肃清, 视野, 范围, 全胜；v.t. 扫除, 掸去, 猛拉, 扫荡, 肃清, 冲走, 刮起, 环视, 掠过, 扫射；v.i. 扫, 打扫, 袭击, 席卷, 扫视, 掠过
The only other sound's the sweep
中文语境：唯一的其他声音是扫频声
guileless /'gailis/ adj. 不狡猾的, 诚实的

He was evidently good, and sweet, and lovable, and guileless; and so it was exceedingly painful to see him stand there, as serene as a graven image, and deliver himself of answers which were veritably miraculous for stupidity and ignorance.
中文语境：他显然是善良的、可爱的、可爱的、诚实的。因此，看到他站在那里，像一尊雕刻的雕像一样平静，并给出对愚蠢和无知来说确实是奇迹般的答案，是极其痛苦的
climactic /klai'mæktik/ adj. 顶点的, 高潮的
Indeed, the zeal of the protesters in April and May of that year led to a climactic legal battle.
中文语境：事实上，当年四月和五月抗议者的热情导致了一场法律斗争的高潮
penalize /'piːnəlaiz/ v.t. 处刑, 对...处罚(刑), 使不利；[法] 处罚, 对...处以刑事惩罚
At this precarious moment, Motley responded by filing a lawsuit in federal court arguing that the school board's action violated the rights of all 1,100 students who had been penalized.
中文语境：在这个岌岌可危的时刻，莫特利向联邦法院提起诉讼作为回应，认为学校董事会的行为侵犯了所有受到处罚的1100名学生的权利
deflect /di'flekt/ v.t. 转移, 使偏斜；v.i. 偏斜
Employing a tactic that Thurgood Marshall had urged fellow Black lawyers to use in the face of bigoted comments, Motley deflected the insult and pushed back with cool professionalism.
中文语境：莫特利采用了瑟古德·马歇尔敦促其他黑人律师在面对偏执评论时使用的策略，转移了侮辱，并以冷静的专业精神进行了反击
disheveled /di'ʃevəld/ adj. 凌乱的,不整洁的
Like a hunted beast breaking cover and dashing madly toward some other haven of momentary safety he threw aside his rug, and struggled frantically into his disheveled garments.
中文语境：就像一头被猎杀的野兽冲破掩体，疯狂地冲向另一个暂时安全的避难所，他扔开地毯，疯狂地挣扎着穿上他凌乱的衣服
terminus /'təːminəs/ n. 终点, 界标, 终点站；[法] 界标, 界牌, 界石

...a lady of about the same age as himself, seemed inclined for slumber rather than scrutiny; the train was not due to stop till the terminus was reached, in about an hour's time, and the carriage was of the oId-fashioned sort that held no communication with a corridor, therefore no further traveling companions were likely to intrude on...
中文语境：...一位与他年龄相仿的女士，似乎更倾向于睡觉而不是仔细观察；火车要到终点站才停下来，大约一个小时后，车厢是老式的，与走廊没有任何联系，因此不可能再有其他旅伴闯入......
levity /'levəti/ n. 轻率, 轻浮, 不稳定
"Surely leaving off one small mouse wouldn't bring on a chill," she exclaimed, with a levity that Theodoric accounted abominable.
中文语境："当然，留下一只小老鼠不会让人感到寒冷，"她大声说道，语气轻浮，狄奥多里克认为这是令人厌恶的
abrade /ə'breid/ v.t. 擦伤, 磨损, 磨；[医] 擦除, 擦破; 磨损, 磨除
The familiar sensation of an abraded shin recalled his dazed faculties.
中文语境：胫骨磨损的熟悉感觉让他想起了茫然的神智
sinuous /'sinjuəs/ adj. 弯弯曲曲的, 迂回的, 运动柔软的；[医] 纡曲的

He saw creeping across the green meadow a sinuous line of figures of men and horses-some foolish commander was permitting the soldiers of his escort to water their beasts in the open, in plain view from a dozen summits!
中文语境：他看到一排蜿蜒的人和马的身影在绿色的草地上爬行--某个愚蠢的指挥官正在允许他的护卫士兵在露天浇灌他们的牲畜，从十几座山峰上都可以清楚地看到！
despondent /di'spɒndənt/ adj. 丧气的, 失望的, 没有精神的
That was a mistake - it had been better to keep the remark to myself; it only gave her an idea - she could save the sick buzzard, and furnish fresh meat to the despondent lions and tigers.
中文语境：那是一个错误--最好把这句话留给我自己；这只是给了她一个想法--她可以拯救生病的秃鹰，并为沮丧的狮子和老虎提供新鲜的肉
coeval /kəu'iːvəl/ adj. 同时代的；n. 同时代的人
"There," she said, with triumph, "that is just it; the Serpent mentioned that very jest, and called it the First Chestnut, and said it was coeval with the creation." Alas, I am indeed to blame.
中文语境："好了，"她胜利地说，"就是这样；蛇提到了这个笑话，并称其为第一栗子，并说它与创造物同时代。"唉，确实是我的错
economize /i'kɒnəmaiz/ v. 节约, 节省, 有效地利用
I think there are many things to learn yet - I hope so; and by economizing and not hurrying too fast I think they will last weeks and weeks.
中文语境：我认为还有很多东西需要学习--我希望如此；通过节约和不要操之过急，我认为它们会持续几周又几周
simplification /.simplifi'keiʃən/ n. 单一化, 单纯化, 简单化
Pushed dumbfounded to beg simplification.
中文语境：推得目瞪口呆，乞求简化
chasm /'kæzəm/ n. 陷窟, 裂口
a mouth, open like a chasm,
中文语境：一张像裂缝一样张开的嘴，
receipt /ri'siːt/ n. 收据, 收入, 收到；v.t. 开...的收据
because the dictator does not give receipts
中文语境：因为独裁者不给收据
multiply /'mʌltiplai/ v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加；[计] 乘
that multiplied the one death by millions
中文语境：使死亡人数增加了数百万
skull /skʌl/ n. 头盖骨, 头脑, 好学生；[医] 头颅
noisy with skulls and bones and dust
中文语境：头骨、骨头和灰尘吵闹
tragedy /'trædʒidi/ n. 悲剧, 惨案, 悲剧作品；[法] 惨事, 灾难, 不辛
The dictator is the director of a great tragedy.
中文语境：独裁者是一场伟大悲剧的导演
contemplative /'kɒntempleitiv/ adj. 沉思的, 爱默想的, 冥想的；[医] 沉思的

Perhaps a germ of love was springing in their hearts so pure that it might blossom in Paradise, since it could not be matured on earth; for women worship such gentle dignity as his, and the proud, contemplative, yet kindly, soul is oftenest captivated by simplicity like hers.
中文语境：也许爱的萌芽正在他们的心中萌芽，这种爱的萌芽如此纯洁，可以在天堂里绽放，因为它无法在地球上成熟；因为女人崇拜他这样温柔的尊严，而骄傲、沉思但又善良的灵魂往往会被她这样的简单所吸引
cataract /'kætərækt/ n. 大瀑布, 奔流, 暴雨, 白内障；[医] 内障, 白内障
Down came the whole side of the mountain in a cataract of ruin.
中文语境：整座山的一侧都塌陷成了一片废墟
forestall /fɒː'stɒːl/ v.t. 预先阻止, 先...一步行动, 占先一步, 垄断, 阻碍；[法] 先采取行动预防或阻止, 垄断

The underground had broken into empty freight cars sealed by the Germans after inspection, helped refugees onto the cars, and then resealed the cars with forged or stolen German seals to forestall further inspection.
中文语境：地下组织闯入德国人检查后封存的空货车，帮助难民登上车厢，然后用伪造或偷来的德国封条重新密封车厢，以阻止进一步检查
infuriate /in'fjuərieit/ adj. 狂怒的；v.t. 激怒
Infuriated, Germany flooded the city with troops, cut off water and electricity, and established a blockade.
中文语境：愤怒的德国派遣军队涌入这座城市，切断水电，并实行封锁
exasperate /ig'zæspəreit/ v.t. 使恼怒, 激怒, 恶化；adj. 糙面的, 恼怒的, 激怒的
Exasperated, the Germans abandoned these punitive measures by July.
中文语境：愤怒的德国人在七月份放弃了这些惩罚措施
fibrosis /fai'brəusis/ n. 纤维变性, 纤维化；[医] 纤维变性, 纤维化
In some patients with cystic fibrosis, this approach has reversed a disease once thought unstoppable.
中文语境：在一些囊性纤维化患者中，这种方法逆转了一度被认为无法阻止的疾病
exporter /ik'spɒːtə/ n. 出口商, 输出者, 出口公司；[经] 出口商, 输出者
Today, our businesses export more than ever, and exporters tend to pay their workers higher wages.
中文语境：如今，我们的企业出口量比以往任何时候都多，出口商往往向工人支付更高的工资
besiege /bi'siːdʒ/ v.t. 围攻, 包围
Soviet forces besieged Warsaw, Poland and Budapest, Hungary as they prepared to push German forces back toward the interior of the Reich.
中文语境：苏联军队围困了波兰华沙和匈牙利布达佩斯，准备将德军推回帝国内地
annihilate /ə'naiəleit/ v.t. 消灭, 废止
A massive Soviet 1944 summer offensive in eastern Belarus annihilated German Army Group Center and permitted Soviet forces to overrun the first of the major Nazi concentration camps, Lublin/Majdanek.
中文语境：1944年夏季，苏联在白俄罗斯东部发动大规模攻势，歼灭了德国中央集团军群，并允许苏联军队占领第一个主要纳粹集中营卢布林/马伊达内克
maintain /mein'tein/ v.t. 维持, 维修, 保持, 坚持, 供养, 主张；[化] 维修
(2) the SS thought they needed prisoners to maintain production of armaments wherever possible;
中文语境：(2) 党卫军认为他们需要囚犯来尽可能维持军备生产；
plumber /'plʌmə/ n. 水管工人；[法] 堵漏防漏人员
It may seem more natural to like a brand that makes an actual product such as a favorite car manufacturer or clothing brand than a service like a plumber, cable provider or pet groomer.
中文语境：与水管工、有线电视提供商或宠物美容师等服务相比，喜欢制造实际产品的品牌（例如最喜欢的汽车制造商或服装品牌）似乎更自然
personalize /'pəːsənəlaiz/ v.t. (贬)使个人化, 体现, 使人格化, 在(物品)上标明姓名/标出地址/标出记号
These companies should perhaps focus more on personalizing their Facebook messages in an attempt to further stimulate and enhance this elevated sense of connectedness.
中文语境：这些公司也许应该更多地关注个性化他们的 Facebook 消息，以试图进一步刺激和增强这种更高的联系感
inundate /'inʌndeit/ v.t. 浸水, 泛滥, 淹没, 使充满
It's difficult to browse the internet without being inundated with requests to like a company's Facebook page or with contests and offers dependent on doing so.
中文语境：浏览互联网时，很难不被点赞公司 Facebook 页面的请求或依赖于此的竞赛和优惠所淹没
pundit /'pʌndit/ n. 学者, 梵文学者, 博学的印度人, 权威

Although passive engagement with followers is perhaps not what gets the most attention when pundits discuss the benefits of Facebook engagement, it still offers benefits, such as becoming more "top of mind." Brand managers should not always assume that their loudest and most active Facebook followers are the only ones getting the message.
中文语境：尽管当专家讨论 Facebook 参与的好处时，与关注者的被动参与可能并不是最受关注的，但它仍然提供了好处，例如变得更加"受关注"。品牌经理不应总是认为他们最响亮、最活跃的 Facebook 粉丝是唯一收到信息的人
initiate /i'niʃieit/ n. 入会, 开始；adj. 新加入的；v.t. 开始, 传授基本知识给
As a result, service companies need to initiate social interactions with their customers in order to communicate value and set appropriate expectations.
中文语境：因此，服务公司需要发起与客户的社交互动，以传达价值并设定适当的期望
canny /'kæni/ adj. 精明的, 谨慎的, 节约的
While con artists can be clever, many can be foiled by knowledgeable - and equally canny - consumers.
中文语境：虽然骗子可能很聪明，但许多骗子可能会被知识渊博且同样精明的消费者挫败
issuer /'iʃjuə/ n. 发行者；[法] 发行人, 发布人
If you see charges you don't recognize or didn't okay, contact your bank, card issuer, or other creditor immediately.
中文语境：如果您发现无法识别或不可接受的费用，请立即联系您的银行、发卡机构或其他债权人
debit /'debit/ n. 借方, 借；v.t. 记入借方
If you get a message and are concerned about your account status, call the number on your credit or debit card - or your statement - and check it out.
中文语境：如果您收到消息并担心您的帐户状态，请拨打您的信用卡或借记卡上的号码 - 或您的对帐单 - 并进行检查
fraud /frɒːd/ n. 欺骗, 欺诈, 诡计, 骗子；[经] 欺诈, 舞弊, 骗子
One bonus tip: Visit OnGuardOnline.gov to learn how to avoid internet fraud, secure your computer and protect your personal information.
中文语境：一项额外提示：访问 OnGuardOnline.gov 了解如何避免互联网欺诈、保护您的计算机并保护您的个人信息
mores /'mɔːriːz/ n. 习惯, 道德态度, 惯例, 习俗；[医] 风俗, 习惯
The slightest infraction of the mores of the Jim Crow south could lead to violence and death.
中文语境：对种族隔离南方的风俗最轻微的违反都可能导致暴力和死亡
recount /ri'kaunt/ v.t. 详述, 叙述, 重新计算；n. 重新计算
"I heard them talking at 2:30 in the morning," Parker recounted.
中文语境："我在凌晨 2:30 听到他们说话，"帕克回忆道
emphasize /'emfəsaiz/ v.t. 强调, 加强语气, 着重
We do not really emphasize his stutter enough," Parker said.
中文语境：我们并没有真正足够重视他的口吃，"帕克说
implant /im'plɑːnt/ v.t. 深植, 灌输, 嵌入；n. 植入物, 植入管
To move normally, patients with Parkinson's take a drug that lets them make more dopamine (or they get an implant that stimulates deep regions of the brain).
中文语境：为了正常活动，帕金森病患者服用一种药物，让他们产生更多的多巴胺（或者他们植入刺激大脑深层区域的植入物）
receptor /ri'septə/ n. 受体, 感觉器官；[化] 接受器; 受体
These messengers then bind to docking-station molecules called receptors.
中文语境：然后这些信使与称为受体的对接站分子结合
stimulate /'stimjuleit/ v.t. 刺激, 激励, 鼓舞；v.i. 起刺激作用
To move normally, patients with Parkinson's take a drug that lets them make more dopamine (or they get an implant that stimulates deep regions of the brain).
中文语境：为了正常活动，帕金森病患者服用一种药物，让他们产生更多的多巴胺（或者他们植入刺激大脑深层区域的植入物）
extradite /'ekstrədait/ v.t. 引渡, 获取(逃犯等)的引渡；[法] 引渡, 使被引渡

Snowden remained in Hong Kong or fled to another country - like Iceland, where he has said he may seek asylum - the charges would strengthen the Justice Department's hand if it tries to extradite him to the United States.
中文语境：斯诺登留在香港或逃往另一个国家--比如冰岛，他曾表示他可能在那里寻求庇护--如果司法部试图将他引渡到美国，这些指控将加强司法部的实力
nefarious /ni'feəriəs/ adj. 恶毒的, 极坏的

He "has damaged national security, our ability to track down terrorists, or those with nefarious intent, and his disclosure has not made America safer," said Representative Jim Langevin, a Rhode Island Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee.
中文语境：众议院情报委员会罗德岛州民主党众议员吉姆·朗之万表示，他"损害了国家安全、我们追查恐怖分子或具有邪恶意图的人的能力，他的披露并没有让美国变得更安全"
multifaceted /.mʌlti'fæsitid/ adj. 多层面的
I think Zainab hit the nail on the head: A "good" depiction for me - not just of Islam, but any religion or culture or character - is one that is nuanced and multifaceted.
中文语境：我认为扎伊纳布说得一中要害：对我来说，"好的"描述--不仅是对伊斯兰教，而且是对任何宗教、文化或人物--是细致入微且多方面的
archetype /'ɑːtʃtaip/ n. 原型
It's not about creating an archetype to represent an entire group, it's not about "getting" or understanding them.
中文语境：这并不是要创建一个原型来代表整个群体，也不是要"获取"或理解它们
well-done /wel'dʌn/ adj. 做得好的, 完全煮熟的
...is a medical doctor, and also briefly became Captain Britain for a time (the comic she appeared in), and her portrayal is well-done.
中文语境：...是一名医生，还曾短暂担任过英国队长（她出现在漫画中），她的刻画非常出色
